meta.title: Convert to a serial bidding auction

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on the buyer's summary page.
Open the conversion flow from the event Settings menu.

args.goal: in the Convert to Auction flow, select the option to reuse RFQ quotes, participants and weights, continue, choose a serial bidding auction, attempt to publish, and verify the refusal message says "Cannot convert rfq to a serial bidding auction"

steps.note: Handle the conversion popup and serial-bidding negative path, which has no dedicated catalog step.
